long_biography.plain_text:
Born in Bern in 1965, Alexander Schärer grew up beside USM's Münsingen factory in a steel-and-glass house designed by Fritz Haller. He studied engineering at the Swiss Federal Institute of Technology in Lausanne, added management training and worked for Procter & Gamble before returning to the family business.

Schärer became managing director and chairman in 2000, succeeding his father as the fourth generation to lead USM. He has pursued international expansion while keeping the modular Haller system compatible with earlier components, extending a design and manufacturing platform created by his father and Fritz Haller. Schärer owns the company with his sister and remains its operating leader.
